# FarOut Guides

> > FarOut Guides provides comprehensive digital trail guides and navigation apps for iOS and Android, helping outdoor enthusiasts explore hiking trails with offline maps and social features.

FarOut (formerly Atlas Guides) is developed by Atlas Guides, LLC based in Flagstaff, Arizona. The platform offers detailed trail guides with social check-in features, follower systems, and comprehensive help documentation for mobile users.

## Key Topics

- FarOut app
- iOS and Android platforms
- Trail navigation
- Social features and check-ins
- Follower system
- Offline maps
- Atlas Guides LLC
- How-to guides and tutorials
- Privacy policy and GDPR
- User data collection

- Mobile app tutorial
- Flagstaff, Arizona
- European Union compliance
